title: Range Product Queries of Powers
summary: For a positive integer n, an array powers is formed with the minimum number of powers of 2 that sum to n, sorted in non-decreasing order.
statement: For a positive integer n, an array powers is formed with the minimum number of powers of 2 that sum to n, sorted in non-decreasing order. Given a 2D array queries, each element [lefti, righti] specifies a range to calculate the product of powers[j] from lefti to righti, inclusive. The result for each query must be returned modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: Represent positive n as the minimum number of distinct powers of two, sorted increasingly.
For each inclusive query [left,right], multiply that slice of powers.
hints: Extract every set bit of n from least significant to most significant.
Each set bit contributes its corresponding power of two, already in increasing order.
Multiply the inclusive query slice while reducing modulo the requested modulus.
Binary representation is the unique minimum-cardinality distinct-power decomposition, so the extracted array and every queried product are exact.
editorial: Binary representation is the unique minimum-cardinality distinct-power decomposition, so the extracted array and every queried product are exact.

tests.explanation: Fifteen decomposes as [1,2,4,8], giving products 2, 4, and 64.
Eight has the single-power representation [8], so the only product is eight.
